disagreements.positions: The Adversary raised possible 409/422 failures; other panelists did not.
disagreements.resolution: Not blocking because the supplied code does not establish that ordinary concurrent comment edits produce those statuses. Concurrent runs could still create duplicate comments, but that is a separate robustness concern.
